articles.title: Iran brands Argentina’s navy and air force terrorists in payback move

Iran retaliated by designating Argentina’s navy and air force as terrorist groups. Buenos Aires cited the Guard’s backing of Hezbollah, which it blames for two deadly 1990s bombings.
